electronic.energy_zero: QE internal; no Fermi/vacuum alignment performed

bands.reference: raw QE eigenvalue energy zero (not vacuum/experimental PL)

grid_selection.policy: exact DOS window; no interpolation or energy shift

pdos_atoms.reference: Raw QE electronic energies; no Fermi/vacuum alignment
limitations: Projected DOS depends on atomic-wavefunction projections and UPF data.
Atom/orbital-resolved DOS is not a direct proof of a localized optical emitter.
Only non-spin-polarized collinear QE projwfc.x output is accepted.
Not an optical transition or single-photon emission measurement.
Spin-polarized/SOC and band-unfolding interpretations are not supported.
Atomic and orbital PDOS projections depend on pseudopotentials and do not establish optical transitions.
DFT numerical convergence must be established independently.
